evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep says: 'I just need to gather details for your move-in order for me to give you an estimated quote, sir. That might take around ten to fifteen minutes. Will that be fine?' — time-boxed and promise present, but no wait for explicit yes before continuing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name (Preston Williams), moving day (Sunday October 11th), route (4th floor to 3rd floor, same building, Dallas addresses confirmed: 2650 North Pita Avenue unit 1428 to 1328), size (one bedroom apartment). All four discovered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves straight into logistics probing without asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (one bedroom apartment), floor/stories (4th to 3rd, same building with elevator), number of rooms (one bedroom), walking distance (approximately 50 feet from elevator for pickup unit, ~100 feet for delivery unit), special items (two TVs 70 and 65 inch, washer/dryer, big couch, tools/toolboxes), additional rooms (kitchen, pantry for partial packing). All seven categories covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Yes: 'Oh, do you need help packing, sir? Of course, yes, we can, the best part we can pack as many and as small as you want.' Later asked specifically which areas: 'which are the area D. would, would you need help packing so at least I can put in here.' Customer responds 'kitchen and pant[ry].'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Yes: 'how many maximum number of boxes do you think are we going to move for you, sir?' Typical range given (15-25 boxes for one bedroom).
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Full: 'typically a one bedroom apartment usually takes just two movers between two and a half to three and a half hours' + personalized: 'In your case since we're going to be moving you from the fourth floor to a third floor apartment with elevator access in the same building with a washer and a big TV that we consider special item to move...And since you requested for partial packing if your kitchen in your which I have approximately estimated to take around one hour to one and a half hour. I'm estimating the move to take around four and a half to five and a half hours only. So including the packing supply, cost of $80. It's good to budget an overall of $98.92119 million for the move.'
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Full: Hourly rate ($202/hour for two movers), inclusions (truck, gas, taxes, insurance, wraps, pads, tools), transparency on no hidden fees (no transportation, credit card, Terrell, or disassemble fees), 2.5-hour minimum, 15-minute increments covered. Also: damage coverage ($2,000 free evaluation coverage, zero deductible) and on-time guarantee (discounts if late).
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. Rep moves directly from estimate to 'Now, okay sir, I still have availability for Sunday 11th of October' without asking 'Does that feel fair?' or waiting for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Full: 'we also have an on time guarantee. So if the movers arrive late, you start to get discount on your final bill. The later they arrive, sir, the bigger your discount will be.' Discount terms clearly stated.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Full: '$2,000 free evaluation coverage that's gonna be either repaired, replace or reimbursed for zero deductible which will be handled within three to five business days.' Covers $2,000, no deductible, no fine print framing explicit.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No. Rep does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' after delivering the two promises. Instead pivots directly to availability and booking.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Throwaway. Rep asks: 'Before we go over pricing structure and estimate, do you have any question any clarification regarding the moving process in general?' This is a generic process question, not a genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' It gets an automatic 'Nope' from the customer.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: No. Rep never asks 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: With out. Rep asks 'So would you want our help with them' (soft ask) immediately followed by customer saying 'I'm looking at, you know what other places getting some other quotes. So I really appreciate the help here and I will get back to you soon' — rep does not close or re-pitch, implying the customer has a built-in out via 'other quotes.'
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: No. Rep does not mention that the quote is rate-locked or good for a specific time period.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (Sunday October 11th), arrival window (8:30 AM to 9:00 AM). Missing: phone number (not confirmed), crew size (two movers mentioned in estimate but not explicitly confirmed at booking), addresses (confirmed earlier but not re-confirmed at close), notes left for crew about customer concerns (none captured).

top_strength: Arden gathered thorough logistics details (floor, distances, special items, TVs, appliances, packing needs) and personalized the estimate directly to this customer's situation (same-building move with elevator, partial packing, special items), making the pricing feel concrete and tailored rather than generic.
coaching_note: Ask "What's still concerning you about this move?" at the final concerns check instead of a generic process question, and ask "Does that feel fair?" after the estimate and genuinely wait for a response before moving to booking — both pauses are load-bearing in the close.
